scheduler.verdict: Smart Scan scores 81/100 versus the sequential sweep - clearly better than the open-loop sweep.

components.label: Interception
components.detail: Smart Scan intercepts 1.97x as many transmissions per timestep as the sequential sweep.

components.label: Discovery
components.detail: Time to first intercept is 0.78x the baseline's and 95.0% of genuinely active bands were found at least once.
components.formula: mean of: baseline censored time-to-intercept / candidate's, and candidate active-band coverage / baseline's

components.label: Prediction
components.detail: Predicts when a band will next be active with 0.81x the baseline's error, and 94.2% of its pre-scan calls were right.
components.formula: mean of: baseline intercept-time error / candidate's, and percentage of correct predictions

context.scale: 50 = parity with the baseline; 100 = twice as good; 0 = half as good
context.ceiling_note: Ceiling assumes a receiver always tuned to an active band, with no dwell, retune or knowledge constraints. It is not reachable.

activity_model.verdict: The activity model scores 88/100 - excellent separation. It predicts whether a band will transmit in the next window from the receiver's own observation history alone.

components.label: Ranking quality
components.detail: ROC-AUC 0.980, PR-AUC 0.927. Given one band that will transmit and one that will not, the model ranks them correctly 98.0% of the time.

components.label: Calibration
components.detail: Expected calibration error 0.0053. When the model says 70%, the band genuinely transmits about that often - which matters because the scheduler multiplies this probability by a weight.

components.label: Skill over base rate
components.detail: Brier score 0.0373 against 0.1441 for always predicting the 17.5% base rate.
components.formula: Brier skill score against the base-rate forecast

context.scale: 0 = no better than chance or badly calibrated; 100 = perfect
